summary_bullets: Fixed get-issue-state flag parsing so missing or flag-looking values fail instead of looping.
Split Codex JSONL event capture from wrapper diagnostics in lint-fix, negotiation, and review-fix paths, then record sanitized token-ledger usage buckets.
Kept raw events.jsonl artifacts local while allowlisting scout-archetype-yield.tsv for committed round logs.
Updated docs, security notes, and regression harnesses for the parser, telemetry, and artifact publication contracts.
commit_message:
Fix orphan script edge cases

Reject missing get-issue-state flag values before shifting argv, capture Codex JSONL usage streams separately from wrapper diagnostics at the remaining non-launcher sites, and allow scout-archetype-yield.tsv through round log publication while keeping raw events streams local.

Add focused regression coverage for the parser guards, Codex telemetry buckets, legacy final-message logs, and events.jsonl exclusion rules.
